name: Ca loc nuong trui
summary: Snakehead grilled in the field style and rolled with seasonal forest leaves. The provincial tourism center's border article puts it with bò tơ, bánh tráng phơi sương, and muối tôm. The homepage also lists it with the old Long An goods. Both placements stay. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: The border article treats it as a countryside plate of Tây Ninh. The homepage groups cá lóc nướng with gạo Nàng Thơm Chợ Đào, thanh long Đức Hòa, rượu đế Gò Đen, lẩu mắm, and khô cá lóc.
howToEat: The border article says roll it with forest leaves that are in season. The fire, the fish size, and a sauce were not printed. Check on arrival.
